training.checkpoint_rule: Final fixed step only; no early stopping, tuning or refit from diagnostics/test results.

primary_metric: Cable pixel AP, equal mean over brightness_070 and gamma_140 within each paired seed
scope: Exploratory small pilot on a previously inspected category, not confirmation or SOTA.
restrictions: Complete all 36 evaluations with no outcome-driven tuning, checkpoint selection or expansion.
All four detectors use the exact same 16 references and eight rotations. A1-A3 fit only 12 of them; the other four provide synthetic diagnostics, never selection.
A1-A3 share initialization, synthetic quadruplets, minibatch indices, optimizer, steps and all scoring settings; only the specified loss differs.
A0 is the unchanged original detector; its zero training cost differs from the adapters and is reported.
Fitting is completed for all seeds before any test images or labels are loaded by this run.
The unchanged normal reference bank is transformed by the same adapter as queries; no synthetic defects or augmented lighting views are added to the deployed bank.
The primary A3 must also improve over A2 to support the cross-light mechanism; a better A1 or A2 cannot be relabeled as the proposed success.
No original source/config/results are overwritten. Main and the preceding experiment branch are preserved.
